semantic_findings.conclusion: The standalone wrapper and Profile sweep create only None. The actual array constructor is reached only after original check_current, fresh checked_file, second check_current and original stamp equality. No array is constructed on those early error paths at Rust source-semantics level.

Hash Context Some exists exactly when immutable self.reference is None. The reference and hash branches use the same immutable predicate throughout; Option borrowing ends before is_some_and consumes Context. No unwrap, unchecked access, new panic branch or fallible acceptance path is introduced.

All nine check_current statements retain original positions. max+1 bounded reader, Interrupted callback and retry, error propagation, EOF callback, length accounting, non-short-circuit reference mismatch, complete verify_read, content error and final success callback remain in original order.

Concrete File/Take reader receives the entire same 16KiB slice. Only [..count] is ever compared or hashed. Per-file length and matches_reference are reset. Stale suffix bytes, empty reads and bytes left after errors are never accepted as new file content.

One exclusively borrowed Option scratch belongs to one synchronous sweep, reused sequentially for five files and shell target. A fresh invocation has its own local; no global, shared field, request-persistent buffer, cross-thread borrow or await is added.

open_absolute, checked_file, verify_read, fixed shell resolution, policy, verify_files, verify_identity and verify_boundaries are part of the exact reverse-byte proof. Fresh component-wise opens, regular-file/owner/mode/capability/bound rules, descriptor/path stamps and worker/owner boundary behavior remain unchanged.

tests.assessment: Six real private fixtures with 3N+7,13,0,N+1,1,0 bytes; both alternating SHA/reference orders. Each shared invocation is compared with a fresh wrapper for result and callback count. Fixtures retain their TempDir ownership until after all calls.

Seeds a previously used buffer, rebases only test stamps after first-byte mismatch, compares fresh/shared mismatch results and checks the same callback count; every pre-success cancellation index must retain cancellation precedence for both SHA and reference modes.

rust_static_assessment: Array/Option and closure types infer from explicit helper parameter; mutable borrows are sequential and Context consumption is after the last loop borrow. No evident type/lifetime issue found. No compiler or Clippy execution is claimed.

resolved_preparation_finding.observed_kind: Static inspection of exact Rust 1.95.0 Clippy source; not an executed Clippy or qualification failure.
resolved_preparation_finding.fix: A private new_verify_buffer() function returns the original initialized 16KiB array. The same original initialization statement now calls get_or_insert_with(new_verify_buffer). The checker only matches an ExprKind::Closure argument, so this named function item does not enter the diagnosed lint branch.
